title: The Gilded Tribunal
setting_summary: In the sealed high-rise courthouse of a corporate city-state, a tribunal hears cases under constant surveillance and a strict 48-hour deadline per trial. The glass-walled chamber, with its remote jury and algorithmic evidence filters, creates an atmosphere of pressure and mistrust where every objection carries career-ending risk.
